tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: Page ground (#0f0b09). Base layer for every section.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Raised layer (#181411): media frames before load, placeholders, cards.

tokens.name: foreground
tokens.usage: Primary text (#f2ece0). 16.65:1 on background, 15.58 on card, 14.21 on popover. The only text colour allowed over video.

tokens.name: fg-secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary text (#c8c2b7): intros, descriptions, second phrases in headings. 11.01 on background, 10.30 card, 9.40 popover. Not over video.

tokens.name: muted-foreground
tokens.usage: Muted text (#a19a92): metadata, indexes, labels. 7.04 on background, 6.59 card, 6.01 popover.

tokens.name: fg-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled text (#6d6863), 3.55 on background. WCAG-exempt; always paired with not-allowed cursor and aria-disabled.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: The one accent, plum (#943b84), for FILLS only: primary button, play chip on hover, selection. Cream label on it 5.55:1. As text it is only 3.00:1, so text and thin marks use primary-text.

tokens.name: primary-foreground
tokens.usage: Cream label on primary fills. 5.55:1 on primary.

tokens.name: primary-text
tokens.usage: Light plum (#da76bb) for accent TEXT and thin marks: link hover, eyebrow rule, active nav line, Commissioned dot, format index hover, step segment, focus ring. 6.81 on background, 6.37 card, 5.81 popover. Never as text over video.

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: shadcn secondary surface; also the disabled button fill.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: shadcn accent = neutral hover surface for menu items and ghost buttons. NOT the brand accent; plum lives on primary.

tokens.name: destructive
tokens.usage: Error (#ed7668): form errors, failed load. 6.86 on background. Always with a text message.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success (#76c788): sent confirmation. 9.55 on background. Always with a text message.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Stronger hairline: tags, link underline at rest, step rules. Decorative, 1.94:1.

tokens.name: input
tokens.usage: Control borders (secondary button, inputs). 3.40:1 on background, meets non-text 3:1.

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 2px solid, 3px offset. 6.81:1 on background.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Warm black (#080503) for scrims over footage. Use at 62–74% behind text, see Text over video.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Hero headline only. Fluid 52→152px: clamp(3.25rem, 0.9286rem + 9.524vw, 9.5rem). Sentence case.

styles.name: h2-contrast
styles.usage: Second phrase of a heading, same roman face and size as h2, in fg-secondary. Same clamp as h2. Once per section at most. No italic in this system.

styles.name: h3
styles.usage: Film titles, step titles. 24→32px: clamp(1.5rem, 1.314rem + 0.7619vw, 2rem). Weight 600 because Cormorant thins out below 32px.

styles.name: body-l
styles.sample: I direct product and brand films, from first frame to final grade.

styles.name: body-m
styles.sample: Every shot is directed, then generated, then cut.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Eyebrows, tags, nav, fact labels. 11→12px. Always UPPERCASE via text-transform.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Indexes, runtimes, aspect ratios, dates. 12→13px. Tabular figures. Case as written.

spacing.note: 4px base. Fixed steps for components; fluid tokens (margin, gutter, section) in the README.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Desktop page margin; small section on mobile.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Standard section on mobile; small section on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-media
tokens.usage: Media frames and the play chip. Just enough to soften the edge.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Menus and dialogs only. Nothing on the page itself casts a shadow.

tokens.name: duration-hover
tokens.usage: Color and border changes on hover.

tokens.name: duration-reveal
tokens.usage: Section and caption reveal on scroll.

tokens.name: duration-media
tokens.usage: Media zoom on hover, poster to video crossfade.

tokens.name: duration-stagger
tokens.usage: Delay between items in a revealing group.

tokens.name: ease-cine
tokens.usage: Reveals, zoom, arrows. Long soft settle, no overshoot.
